author: Aizat Tanibergen
title: Lately
paragraphs: I've been thinking about how quickly things change. Some days feel familiar, others don't. You go to the same places, see the same things, but somehow it's not quite the same anymore.

author: Aizat Tanibergen
title: People
paragraphs: I've been thinking about people and relationships lately. Sometimes I wonder if all the effort is worth it. I like having people around, but there are times when I don't really know what I want from them, or what they want from me. I haven't figured it out. It's just been on my mind.

author: Aizat Tanibergen
title: August
paragraphs: The health scare I wrote about last year is behind me now. Treatment is over, and I don't have to think about it every day anymore.
I left my office job in March, too. I wouldn't say I've figured out what comes next. I'm still trying things and changing my mind, but I do feel a bit better about the way I'm living.

author: Aizat Tanibergen
title: Raim
paragraphs: Met Raim today through Nadir's circle. He's a cool guy, and it's been really nice talking to him.
I haven't had much of a social life for the last few years, so getting to know new people again feels good. I'd forgotten how much I missed having friends.

author: Aizat Tanibergen
title: Her birthday
paragraphs: Celebrated her birthday today. It was nice, but I don't think she enjoyed it that much. It wasn't what she'd planned, and we didn't end up going abroad like she had hoped.
Last year's birthday was better, at least that's how she felt. This one didn't quite go to plan.

author: Aizat Tanibergen
title: A ladybug
paragraphs: Went for a walk in the mountains sometime this summer. A ladybug landed on me and stayed there for a bit. I got ridiculously happy about it. It was such a tiny thing, but it made me smile for the rest of the walk.

author: Aizat Tanibergen
title: Someone close
paragraphs: Something difficult happened around this time. Someone very close to me was going through a vulnerable period, and I felt awful seeing it.
I couldn't fix everything, but I wanted to do what I could to make things a little easier and more stable for them. I don't want to write about the details here.

author: Aizat Tanibergen
title: Last day at the office
paragraphs: March 20 was my last day at the office. After a few years there, I decided to leave.
It's strange to finish something that has been part of your everyday life for so long. I don't really know what comes next yet.

author: Aizat Tanibergen
title: A birthday cheesecake
paragraphs: It was my birthday today, and I ran into Nadir at Pasta La Vista in Almaty. We hadn't really talked for three or four years, so I wasn't expecting to see him.
He was there with his girlfriend. He ordered a cheesecake for me, but didn't come over or interrupt my evening. He just sat with her, looked over and smiled. Before that, he told me he'd missed me.
It was a really nice surprise. Nadir is a good guy.

author: Aizat Tanibergen
title: Seeing someone again
paragraphs: Saw someone again today. It was unexpected, and I wasn't quite sure what to say. Some things are difficult to explain, especially when you haven't seen a person for a while.
Anyway, it was good to see them.

author: Aizat Tanibergen
title: December 20
paragraphs: I found out I had skin cancer today. I wasn't expecting that, and I don't really know what to write about it yet.
It's a lot to take in. I don't feel like sharing all the details here, so for now I'll leave it at that.
